ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with localized mid-intensity (grey) regions; estimated macro-level ratio of high-to-low intensity pixels is approximately 1:8.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Darkest pixel regions are concentrated at the medial peduncle insertion and along the superior trailing edge. Lighter, mottled grey regions occupy the central-medial portions of both lobes. Distinct high-intensity white punctate spots are distributed along the inferior margin and terminal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 75 degrees; bounding-box depth is roughly 15% of the total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations extracted along the entire superior trailing edge; pixel amplitude of vertical deviations is greatest at the mid-lobe regions, tapering toward the terminal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the inferior distal margins transitioning to a sharp upward sweep at the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (1-5 pixel diameter) concentrated along the inferior proximal boundary and heavily clustered on both terminal distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible across both lobes; a prominent diagonal mark on the left lobe spans approximately 20% of the lobe width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple parallel rake marks across both lobes; irregular, ragged topography on both terminal tips indicating significant tissue disruption and scarring.
